build_check.description: index.html and game_logic.js exist, a canvas/WebGL renderer is present, and no disallowed heavy runtime asset references are used.

requirements.description: Explore a studio backlot with at least three themed stages, backstage corridors, prop storage, and unlockable shortcuts. Score 0 if the system is absent, decorative, or cannot be completed through player input. Score 1 requires the full interaction and its success/failure consequences to be observable in one playable flow.

Perform interactive audition scenes by hitting movement, dialogue, lighting, and camera marks in the correct dramatic sequence. Score 0 if the system is absent, decorative, or cannot be completed through player input. Score 1 requires the full interaction and its success/failure consequences to be observable in one playable flow.

Manipulate rotating sets, spotlights, curtains, and practical effects to reveal paths and appease or provoke the studio presence. Score 0 if the system is absent, decorative, or cannot be completed through player input. Score 1 requires the full interaction and its success/failure consequences to be observable in one playable flow.

Meet spectral cast members with distinct motives and recover production notes that alter scene objectives. Score 0 if this content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes the player's decisions.

Track composure and audience approval; mistakes should distort sets, summon hazards, or rewrite the current scene. Score 0 if this content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes the player's decisions.

Complete a final live take that combines previous mechanics and branches according to the roles and truths the player accepted. Score 0 if this content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes the player's decisions.

Successful takes earn role tokens that unlock new stage controls, costumes with abilities, and access to the sealed director's wing. Score 0 if this content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes the player's decisions.

The HUD clearly communicates current objective, critical resources, selected target or mode, progress, and danger states in stable regions. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from the game state at 1280x720.

Every important player action has immediate, distinguishable feedback for valid input, invalid input, success, damage or failure, and state change. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from the game state at 1280x720.

The full loop is connected: styled title and start flow, playable core systems, progression or escalation, final success/failure state, and retry or return navigation all work without reloading the page. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from the game state at 1280x720.

The project has a coherent authored art direction: Decaying golden-age cinema with dusty spotlights, velvet reds, monochrome projections, painted backdrops, and theatrical supernatural transitions. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes. Full credit may be earned with runtime-authored procedural textures, layered materials, deliberate multi-light rigs, particles, synthesized audio, or post-processing; external asset files are not required.

The 3D environment has deliberate composition, lighting, material contrast, depth cues, and themed landmarks rather than an empty floor with scattered objects. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.

Primary interactive actors, machines, targets, hazards, and UI symbols have readable silhouettes and visibly different functional states. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.

Movement, impacts, transitions, alerts, completion moments, and interface changes use smooth multi-frame animation, particles, camera treatment, or audio-reactive motion. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.
